# Alcoa Turns Raw Potential into Real Progress

Building a Legacy of Excellence for Future Generations

## Inspired by our vision and guided by our values

### Creating Impact

Our vision is to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. We’ll realize this vision by
running the safest and most reliable operations in the industry while growing our people and shaping
the future. We're turning today's work into a stronger future - not just for Alcoa, but for the
industry and world we help build.

### Our Commitment

Every day, you’ll find us striving to protect the safety and health of our global workforce and our
environment. We actively engage with our stakeholders in the communities where we operate. We are
focused on not just today, but tomorrow as well - for the people and communities who come next.

### Our People

From purposeful career development and inclusive and diverse work teams, Alcoa employees turn raw
potential into real progress. Today, we continue to channel the determination that first launched an
industry. We’re leading with the same boldness that shaped our history - and setting a new standard
that others will look to for generations.
